import sqlite3,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite')
db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(p)+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
x=db.execute("SELECT account_id,site_id,agent_id FROM device_bindings WHERE id=1 AND sim_slot=0 AND status='active'").fetchone()
out={'current_binding':dict(x) if x else None}
if x:
 q="""SELECT ag.id,ag.name,ag.status,ag.site_id,COUNT(v.id) AS versions,MAX(v.revision) AS latest_revision
  FROM agents ag LEFT JOIN agent_flow_versions v ON v.agent_id=ag.id AND v.account_id=ag.account_id AND v.site_id=ag.site_id
  WHERE ag.account_id=? AND ag.site_id=? GROUP BY ag.id ORDER BY ag.id"""
 out['same_site_agents']=[dict(z) for z in db.execute(q,(x['account_id'],x['site_id']))]
 out['account_agents']=[dict(z) for z in db.execute('SELECT id,site_id,name,status FROM agents WHERE account_id=? ORDER BY id',(x['account_id'],))]
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
